notes: Two green bilingual Croatian/Serbian Cyrillic street blades on one pole in Dalj (Erdut municipality); target is the lower, nearer blade. The upper blade 'ULICA ZAGREBAČKA / улица ЗАГРЕБАЧКА' is a second street name; the tiny crest text 'OPĆINA ERDUT' is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jernej Furman from Slovenia
attribution: Photo: Jernej Furman from Slovenia, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Motovun_sign_for_street_(52829256701).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Grey stencil-lettered bilingual plate on a stone wall, Motovun, seen at an angle with a plant growing over the top edge. 'POVJESNICAR' shows no caron on the C; a stray mark under the C of ULICA is damage, not a letter. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jernej Furman from Slovenia
attribution: Photo: Jernej Furman from Slovenia, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gift_shops_sign_in_Hum_(52829260661).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted wooden direction boards for gift shops in Hum (Istria), half in shadow. Target is the upper 'IMELA' board (no spaces after commas). The lower board 'SHOP COLMO / CRAFT BEER - WINE - BRANDY / ... / COFFEE' names a second shop and is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
